method.note: 2025 RUS awards model built from the fall 2025 Deseret school-year archive, RUS 2025 team records and no estimated missing stats. All-State, All-Region, All-Utah and All-Rural position teams use the shared position formulas (2026-08-17-v1). Offensive award positions count passing + rushing + receiving, defensive stats are excluded from offensive-position scoring, and run-first QBs receive enhanced rushing credit. Final team displays exclude a Player of the Year from that same First/Second Team and use the remaining ranked players for honorable mention.
